title: onboard-orion-lite-5b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Orion Lite 5B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog updates. Motivation: Orion Lite 5B is a cost-efficient 5B-parameter variant requested by product for low-latency assistant use cases. This PR adds the canonical metadata package, calibrated perf profiles for supported instance types, and extends the changelog automation so that new model onboarding entries are surfaced in release notes automatically. Checklist: * add model metadata YAML (name, architecture, tokenizer, licenses) * add perf profile JSONs (throughput/latency/kv-cache behavior) * integrate weights/manifests with registry index * wire changelog automation to include new model metadata when merged to main * add unit and integration tests for the onboarding pipeline * update docs quickstart excerpt. Notes: perf numbers were produced on the perf-lab (A100-80GB and RTX-6000) using the standardized harness. This change also contains a small bugfix to changelog_generator to prevent duplicate entries when two model PRs land in the same release window.
